query: Among these measured static findings, identify the most concrete recoverable missing-code seed: an address classified undefined by the saved Ghidra coverage, directly targeted by one or more calls from saved functions, for which pinned PS2Recomp emitted a separate bounded function body from the same executable.

top.text: The target address 0x001fc0d0 falls within Ghidra .text undefined range 0x001fbfb8-0x001fc277. Three saved jal references from 0x001fbe48 target it. Pinned PS2Recomp generated a separate sub_001FC0D0 function spanning 0x001fc0d0-0x001fc118, 18 words.

Saved Ghidra coverage: 32,788 instruction bytes in .text are not owned by functions. Most are already represented by generated output; 728 unowned instruction words with no generated instruction comment are all zero words.
Saved Ghidra coverage marks executable block .vutext, 13,696 bytes from 0x00217be0-0x0021b15f, with zero EE instructions. VU interpretation requires a separate architecture audit.
A Ghidra candidate_leaf_0022a180 appears in the function inventory but has no inbound references. Its 18 instructions do not appear in the 4746-function PS2Recomp output.
